behavior.replacement_growth: Rust builds the replacement SmallVec before publishing it. A panicking T::default preserves the previous size and value. Pinned native does the same, but leaks its partially constructed raw replacement buffer; Rust drops that partial allocation, so this exception path remains partial.
behavior.const_to_array1: Pinned native const ToArray1 returns a mutable Array1 alias to the original buffer (12 77 after alias mutation). Rust exposes a safe copy-on-write view; mutation detaches and leaves the LocalArray unchanged. This remains partial rather than using unsafe aliasing.
